title: Welcome to India
description: India isn't a country you visit — it's a country you feel. A land of 1.4 billion people and 700 languages. #india #incredibleindia #travel #culture

scenes.text: This is India. A country that overwhelms every sense you have.
Where ancient temples stand beside glass skyscrapers.
Where 1.4 billion people speak more than 700 languages.
Where chaos and calm somehow live side by side.
And a stranger will welcome you home like family.
India isn't a country you visit. It's a country you feel.
